development.execution: ProcessPoolExecutor (one job per stock, one per panel/sensitivity run); threadpool_limits(1) per worker; models n_jobs=1, fixed seed 42; results assembled in frozen matrix order

matrix.aapl_reproducibility: amendment 01 tier 2 on the 66 AAPL A/E comparisons vs Phase 10A (diagnostic only)

evaluation.dev_cut: price bars cut at the development end BEFORE features and targets are built

classification: Per-Stock Base Rate (training-fold share of each stock)
regression: Per-Stock Mean Return (training-fold mean of each stock)

panel.dm: per-date cross-sectional mean loss: for every OOS date the model and the reference losses are averaged over the stocks present on that date; the existing one-sided diebold_mariano is applied to the per-date series with Newey-West (h - 1) lags
panel.folds: TimeSeriesSplit(20) over the unique development trading DATES with gap = h dates; every stock's rows on a date belong to the same fold
panel.gate: gate_v1 decision logic unchanged on the pooled OOS population: regression MSE < reference AND DM p < 0.05; classification log loss < reference AND DM p < 0.05 AND accuracy >= Always UP
panel.model: one model per walk-forward fold trained on the pooled training observations
panel.reference: regression: the baseline with the lowest pooled OOS MSE; classification: the lower pooled OOS log loss of the two base rates; Always UP is the accuracy floor
panel.rows: all eligible stocks pooled; one row per (stock, session)

families.note: stage-level Holm (66 / 1,914) as instructed for 11A; the frozen Phase 11 design fixes the final families at 198 / 5,742 across 11A + 11B, so any 11A qualifier is PROVISIONAL until 11B completes the frozen families

matrix.qualification: gate_v1 QUALIFIED AND raw DM p < 0.05 AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 within the family

classification.name: excess_direction_1d
classification.rule: direction = 1 (UP) if future_excess_return > 0 else 0 (DOWN); zero -> DOWN; no dead zone

1.future_spy_use: target construction only; never a feature
1.price: split- and dividend-adjusted closes (total returns); simple returns, no log, no normalization
